seo.title: Services
seo.description: Web development, product engineering, mobile development and codebase rescue. A short list of things we do deeply, in TypeScript.

hero.heading: Four things, done properly
hero.description: We would rather be genuinely good at a few things than available for everything. Here is what we take on, and what we deliberately do not.

funnelExplanation.heading: How the four fit together
paragraphs: Three of these build software: a web application, a product with customers and billing behind it, or an app in the stores. Which one you need is usually obvious within ten minutes of the first call, and sometimes the answer is that you need two of them.

The fourth is different. Codebase Rescue takes over software that already exists and is not safe to run — inherited from an agency that moved on, a developer who left, or an AI coding tool. It is our specialism, and it feeds everything else: reading other people's failures is the fastest way to learn what not to build.

whatWeDontDo.heading: What we don't do
whatWeDontDo.description: Being specific about this saves everyone a call, and a studio that claims everything is telling you nothing.
items: Brand identity, logo design or naming — we will happily work alongside whoever does.
Marketing, SEO campaigns, content strategy or paid acquisition.
Games, real-time 3D, or embedded and hardware firmware.
Ongoing development in stacks we do not work in. We will say so rather than learn on your budget.
Penetration testing or formal security certification. We find the obvious holes; we are not an accredited auditor.
Staff augmentation by the hour. Our dedicated team model is close, but it comes with our standards attached.

cta.heading: Not sure which one you need?
cta.description: That is a normal place to start. One conversation is usually enough to work it out, and we will tell you if the answer is none of them.
